findings.evidence: `IsContinuousCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi` exposes `continuousOn` and `isCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi` in `Basic.lean:456-460`, exactly the two components used by the proof at lines 214-222; `hausdorff_bernstein_widder` itself characterizes this weaker predicate.
findings.fix: State the closure theorem on `IsContinuousCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi`, using its continuity and open-half-line components, and make the strong-predicate and representation forms consequences of it.
findings.issue: The main closed-half-line composition theorem accepts only `IsCompletelyMonotone g`, although its result and required data need only `IsContinuousCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi g`; the same overrestriction propagates to `exists_representsLaplace_comp_isBernsteinFunction` at line 261.

summary: The composition API unnecessarily requires the stronger closed-half-line smoothness predicate for the outer function, excluding the library's canonical Hausdorff–Bernstein–Widder class.
